title: If Jesus came back tonight, would you actually be ready?
paragraphs: If Jesus came back tonight, would you actually be ready?

Not someday.
Not “when I fix my life.”
Not “when I’m older.”

The Bible warns that Christ’s return will come suddenly — like a thief in the night. One moment people will be living their normal lives… working, scrolling, laughing, planning tomorrow. Then in an instant, eternity will begin.

No warning.
No countdown.
No second chances.
“Be ye also ready: for in such an hour as ye think not the Son of man cometh.” — Matthew 24:44
The real question isn’t whether Jesus will return. Scripture already settled that.
The real question is whether we’re ready when He does.
Many people assume they’re ready because they’re “good people.” Others think going to church occasionally is enough. Some believe they still have plenty of time to think about eternity.
But none of us are promised tomorrow.
Life can change in a moment.
Salvation isn’t about being perfect — it’s about putting your faith in Jesus Christ, turning from sin, and trusting the One who died and rose again to save you.

If Christ appeared tonight…
Would your heart feel peace or panic?
Would you run toward Him… or wish you had more time?
Someone else might need this reminder today.
